body.x: Yujin Robot (CEO Park Sung-joo) announced its participation in CES 2024, which will be held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday) local time.

Yujin Robot will exhibit products and services such as factory automation, autonomous mobile robots, research portable platform demo kits, LiDAR sensors, SLAM technology, and driving software tailored to Industry 4.0 and Logistics 4.0. Additionally, it offers an end-to-end robotics solution, transforming and strengthening manual machines to observe the surrounding environment, think appropriately, and operate. It can support various companies, from those handling materials in manufacturing, transportation, and storage to the most futuristic-oriented enterprises. The technology accumulated through such expertise is applied across multiple forward-looking fields - logistics, material manufacturing, transportation, storage, smart factories, factories, hospitals, and more.

With 30 years of expertise in factory automation since 1988, Yujin Robot has produced and supplied assembly automation equipment in the automotive parts, semiconductor, and heavy industry sectors. As the officials explain, it provides optimized solutions for automation systems such as lines, cells, and standalone equipment, along with thorough post-management, inspections, and a rapid company response system.

Moreover, the company supplies logistics automation solutions based on their independently developed autonomous driving AMR. They emphasize the strength of completing the optimal smart factory environment through a factory automation system integrated with robots. A Yujin Robot official stated, “As a first-generation domestic robot company, we offer end-to-end robotics solutions for logistics automation and factory automation systems through our autonomous mobile platform GoCart, enhancing production efficiency and providing customer satisfaction values in warehouses, factories, hospitals, and beyond.”

Additionally, leveraging DPS (Digital Picking System), Yujin Robot supports digital order-picking operations without separate vouchers, displaying picking quantities digitally on frequently used digital displays in logistics fields. DPS Cart, combined with GoCart, transfers items to designated locations without manual intervention.

body.x: Furthermore, Yujin Robot has successfully established an automated system by introducing AMR into various domestic and international hospitals. An official highlighted, “As hospital robots continue to evolve in application and technology, they are increasingly becoming a crucial means established in a wide range of fields in hospitals and other medical facilities. Introducing AMRs into hospitals can enhance work efficiency while reducing costs, employee injuries, and possible accidents.”

body.x: Yujin Robot cites its strengths in providing customers convenience and efficiency through its independently developed 3D LiDAR, SLAM, Navigation Controller, Safety Controller, and a robot control system (FMS, Fleet Management System). Its factory assembly automation equipment has already been delivered to more than six countries, with partnerships and close cooperation with customers and partners such as Continental and Vitesco. Additionally, the company is establishing an office in Munich, Germany, and planning to expand into the European market. While its autonomous logistics robots have footprints in European and Southeast Asian countries, Yujin Robot intends to establish offices and expand business in North America and Europe.

The representative said, “By participating in CES 2024, we aim to introduce Yujin Robot’s diverse solutions, validated in various domestic and international companies, to the overseas market, improve recognition, and secure customers in North America and Europe.”
